The council convened to address Item 14, a communication from Councilwoman Zendejas and Councilmember Urunga recommending a $1,500 increase in appropriations for the City Manager Department to support the 2021 Hope Latina Empowerment Day. Councilmember Urunga opened the discussion by thanking staff and colleagues for their support. He emphasized that the COVID-19 pandemic had necessitated the cancellation or scaling back of numerous city events, making it critical to utilize available resources to support community organizations. Urunga highlighted the importance of sustaining neighborhood activation efforts, particularly for Latino and Latina residents, and expressed pride in partnering with Hope to serve local families and the broader city. He extended gratitude to the organization for its ongoing work.

Following the remarks, a motion was put forward and seconded by Councilman de House. The council proceeded to the public comment period, during which no comments were received. The body then conducted a roll call vote on the recommendation. All nine districts voted in favor of the measure. The vote was recorded as follows: District 1, Yes; District 2, Yes; District 3, Yes; District 4, Yes; District 5, Yes; District 6, Yes; District 7, Yes; District 8, Yes; and District 9, Yes. The item was approved by unanimous consent. No further next steps or additional actions were explicitly outlined in the provided transcript beyond the passage of the appropriation.
